break_conditions: Candidate bundles and tasks have unequal sizes; card count alone does not bound token cost or completion time.
Fan-out, retries, abandoned jobs and shared source documents need explicit permit accounting.
Limiting starts does not prove an endpoint is owned, nor that a subscriber is ready.
Source manufacturing throughput findings are not observed research labor savings.
counterexample: With two startup permits, two processes may still choose the same unreserved port. A WIP bound can hold while Q10-P1 fails. Also CONWIP can push jobs between stations after line admission: the word pull does not define every internal interface.
